vectors.name: valid-in-plan-action
vectors.description: Valid action at plan node n2 with a 1-hop chain.

vectors.name: valid-plan-node-n1
vectors.description: Valid action at plan node n1 (exercises a different Merkle path in a 5-leaf tree).

vectors.name: valid-plan-node-n3
vectors.description: Valid action at plan node n3 (exercises a different Merkle path in a 5-leaf tree).

vectors.name: valid-plan-node-n4
vectors.description: Valid action at plan node n4 (exercises a different Merkle path in a 5-leaf tree).

vectors.name: valid-plan-node-n5
vectors.description: Valid action at plan node n5 (exercises a different Merkle path in a 5-leaf tree).

vectors.name: out-of-plan-action
vectors.description: Action not in the committed plan, correctly signed: plan_inclusion fails.

vectors.name: tampered-params
vectors.description: params_digest altered after signing: plan_inclusion and leaf_signature fail.

vectors.name: tampered-params-resigned
vectors.description: params_digest altered and re-signed by the right key: only plan_inclusion fails.

vectors.name: wrong-key-leaf-signature
vectors.description: Signed by a key that is not the leaf holder: leaf_signature fails.

vectors.name: tampered-counter-after-signing
vectors.description: counter modified after signing: leaf_signature fails.

vectors.name: invalid-counter
vectors.description: Negative counter (re-signed): counter check fails.

vectors.name: tampered-merkle-proof
vectors.description: A sibling hash in the inclusion proof is replaced: plan_inclusion fails.

vectors.name: tampered-conditions-digest
vectors.description: conditions_digest swapped for another: plan_inclusion fails.

vectors.name: delegated-2-hop-chain
vectors.description: Two-hop chain (agent delegates to sub-agent, appending a caveat); leaf signed by the sub-agent.

vectors.name: delegated-leaf-signed-by-parent-holder
vectors.description: Chain is fine but the leaf was signed by the parent holder, not the sub-agent: leaf_signature fails.

vectors.name: chain-dropped-caveat
vectors.description: Child hop drops the parent caveat B (validly signed, parent-linked): chain fails.

vectors.name: chain-reordered-caveat
vectors.description: Child hop reorders the parent caveats (validly signed): chain fails.

vectors.name: chain-edited-caveat
vectors.description: Child hop widens a parent caveat (validly signed): chain fails.

vectors.name: chain-hop-signed-by-wrong-key
vectors.description: Child hop signed by a key that is not the parent holder: chain fails.

vectors.name: chain-hops-reordered
vectors.description: The two hops are swapped: chain fails.

vectors.name: chain-root-not-grant
vectors.description: Chain root is a different principal's capability than the grant: chain fails.

vectors.name: valid-with-optional-slots
vectors.description: ver-2 body carrying every optional signed slot (nonce, caution, rationale_commitment, progress_step, prohibition_evidence, tool_binding): signed, so they are part of the hash; verifies.

vectors.name: valid-with-unsigned-threshold-container
vectors.description: A `threshold` container is NOT part of the signed body: adding shares does not break the leaf signature.

vectors.name: valid-raw-json-format-insensitive
vectors.description: Raw JSON text with indentation, reversed key order, \u escapes and \/ : parses (strict profile) to the same value; format never changes the verdict.

vectors.name: valid-chain-at-depth-cap-16
vectors.description: A chain of exactly 16 capabilities (the cap) verifies. Hop keys are sha256("atlas-pca-conformance/hop<i>").

vectors.name: chain-17-hops-rejected
vectors.description: A validly signed chain of 17 capabilities exceeds the 16-hop cap: chain fails (rejected before any signature work).

vectors.name: ver-1-rejected
vectors.description: ver=1 (re-signed): version fails. v2 is a clean break.

vectors.name: ver-3-rejected
vectors.description: ver=3 (re-signed): version fails.

vectors.name: audience-mismatch
vectors.description: aud does not equal the verifier's audience: audience fails (cross-server / cross-instance replay).

vectors.name: expired
vectors.description: now = exp + 1: validity fails.

vectors.name: valid-at-exp-boundary
vectors.description: now == exp is still valid (expiry is `now > exp`).

vectors.name: iat-future-beyond-skew
vectors.description: iat is 60,001 ms in the future: validity fails.

vectors.name: valid-iat-within-skew
vectors.description: iat is exactly 60,000 ms in the future: still valid.

vectors.name: lifetime-too-long
vectors.description: exp - iat = 3,600,001 ms (> 1 h): validity fails.

vectors.name: valid-max-lifetime
vectors.description: exp - iat = exactly 3,600,000 ms: valid.

vectors.name: exp-not-after-iat
vectors.description: exp == iat: validity fails (exp must be > iat).

vectors.name: tampered-exp-after-signing
vectors.description: exp extended after signing: the freshness fields are SIGNED, so leaf_signature fails.

vectors.name: tampered-aud-after-signing
vectors.description: aud rewritten after signing: audience fails and leaf_signature fails.

vectors.name: tampered-optional-slot-after-signing
vectors.description: caution lowered after signing: optional slots are signed, so leaf_signature fails.

vectors.name: forge-smallorder-leaf-identity-holder
vectors.description: The grant's holder is the identity public key and the leaf signature is the forged (R=identity, S=0) value: leaf_signature MUST fail (strict RFC 8032 + reject small-order keys). Needs no private key.

vectors.name: forge-smallorder-leaf-order2-holder
vectors.description: The grant's holder is the order2 public key and the leaf signature is the forged (R=identity, S=0) value: leaf_signature MUST fail (strict RFC 8032 + reject small-order keys). Needs no private key.

vectors.name: forge-smallorder-root-issuer
vectors.description: The grant root issuer is the identity key and its signature is the forged (R=identity, S=0) value: chain MUST fail. The leaf is genuinely signed by the holder.

vectors.name: b64u-noncanonical-sig-tail
vectors.description: sig has non-zero unused trailing bits in its last base64url char (decodes to the same 64 bytes in a lax decoder): wire fails.

vectors.name: b64u-noncanonical-proof-hash-tail
vectors.description: A Merkle sibling hash has non-canonical trailing bits: wire fails.

vectors.name: b64u-noncanonical-chain-sig-tail
vectors.description: A capability signature in cap_chain has non-canonical trailing bits: wire fails.

vectors.name: b64u-whitespace-in-sig
vectors.description: sig contains an embedded newline: wire fails.

vectors.name: b64u-padding-in-sig
vectors.description: sig carries "=" padding: wire fails (unpadded base64url only).

vectors.name: b64u-standard-alphabet
vectors.description: plan.root uses "+" (standard base64 alphabet): wire fails.

vectors.name: b64u-wrong-length-sig
vectors.description: sig decodes to the wrong byte length: wire fails.

vectors.name: merkle-index-plus-one
vectors.description: inclusion_proof.index + 1 (re-signed): plan_inclusion fails (index is bound to the path shape).

vectors.name: merkle-index-minus-one
vectors.description: inclusion_proof.index = -1 (re-signed): plan_inclusion fails.

vectors.name: merkle-index-equals-size
vectors.description: inclusion_proof.index == size (re-signed): plan_inclusion fails.

vectors.name: merkle-size-zero
vectors.description: inclusion_proof.size = 0 (re-signed): plan_inclusion fails.

vectors.name: merkle-size-doubled
vectors.description: inclusion_proof.size = 2*size (re-signed, path shape no longer matches): plan_inclusion fails.

vectors.name: merkle-size-missing
vectors.description: inclusion_proof.size absent: wire fails.

vectors.name: merkle-index-non-integer
vectors.description: inclusion_proof.index = 1.5: wire fails (index/size are safe integers).

vectors.name: merkle-index-string
vectors.description: inclusion_proof.index is the string "1": wire fails.

vectors.name: merkle-path-side-flipped
vectors.description: A proof step side L/R flipped (re-signed): plan_inclusion fails.

vectors.name: conditions-digest-number-0
vectors.description: plan.conditions_digest is 0 (non-string, re-signed): wire fails (no silent fallback to the default digest).

vectors.name: conditions-digest-object
vectors.description: plan.conditions_digest is {} (non-string, re-signed): wire fails (no silent fallback to the default digest).

vectors.name: conditions-digest-false
vectors.description: plan.conditions_digest is false (non-string, re-signed): wire fails (no silent fallback to the default digest).

vectors.name: conditions-digest-null
vectors.description: plan.conditions_digest is null (non-string, re-signed): wire fails (no silent fallback to the default digest).

vectors.name: conditions-digest-array
vectors.description: plan.conditions_digest is [] (non-string, re-signed): wire fails (no silent fallback to the default digest).

vectors.name: wire-missing-aud
vectors.description: aud absent: wire fails.

vectors.name: wire-missing-exp
vectors.description: exp absent: wire fails.

vectors.name: wire-aud-not-string
vectors.description: aud is a number: wire fails.

vectors.name: wire-unknown-top-level-field
vectors.description: An unknown top-level field (signed): wire fails (closed field set).

vectors.name: wire-counter-string
vectors.description: counter is the string "7": wire fails.

vectors.name: wire-counter-non-integer
vectors.description: counter = 1.5 (object form): wire fails.

vectors.name: wire-caution-out-of-range
vectors.description: caution = 2: wire fails ([0,1] only).

vectors.name: wire-iat-float
vectors.description: iat = 1800000000000.5: wire fails (integers only).

vectors.name: wire-risk-r-too-precise
vectors.description: risk_claim.r = 0.30000000000000004 (17 significant digits): wire fails (max 15).

vectors.name: wire-risk-r-exponent
vectors.description: risk_claim.r = 1e-7 (needs an exponent form): wire fails.

vectors.name: wire-unsafe-integer-in-caveat
vectors.description: A caveat contains the integer 9007199254740992 (2^53): wire fails (safe range).

vectors.name: wire-lone-surrogate-in-string
vectors.description: aud contains a lone surrogate U+D800 (object form): wire fails.

vectors.name: wire-too-deep-risk-inputs
vectors.description: risk_claim.inputs nests 40 arrays deep (object form): wire fails (max depth 32).

vectors.name: json-counter-float-1.0
vectors.description: Raw JSON counter is 7.0 (integer-valued float literal): rejected.

vectors.name: json-counter-exponent-7e0
vectors.description: Raw JSON counter is 7e0: rejected.

vectors.name: json-counter-2pow53-plus-1
vectors.description: Raw JSON counter is 9007199254740993 (2^53+1; rounds to ...992 in a double): rejected.

vectors.name: json-counter-2pow53
vectors.description: Raw JSON counter is 9007199254740992 (2^53): rejected (safe range is |n| <= 2^53-1).

vectors.name: json-counter-1e21
vectors.description: Raw JSON counter is 1e21: rejected.

vectors.name: json-counter-negative-zero
vectors.description: Raw JSON counter is -0: rejected.

vectors.name: json-counter-leading-zero
vectors.description: Raw JSON counter is 07: rejected.

vectors.name: json-r-trailing-zero
vectors.description: Raw JSON risk_claim.r is 0.0 (trailing fractional zero): rejected.

vectors.name: json-comment-block
vectors.description: A /* */ comment inside the document: rejected (the Ruby JSON gem accepts these).

vectors.name: json-comment-inside
vectors.description: A /* */ comment between members: rejected.

vectors.name: json-comment-line
vectors.description: A // line comment: rejected.

vectors.name: json-lone-surrogate-escape
vectors.description: aud contains the escape \ud800 with no low surrogate: rejected.

vectors.name: json-lone-low-surrogate-escape
vectors.description: aud contains a lone low surrogate escape \udc00: rejected.

vectors.name: json-surrogate-pair-reversed
vectors.description: aud contains \ude00\ud83d (low then high): rejected.

vectors.name: json-nesting-too-deep
vectors.description: risk_claim.inputs nests 100 arrays deep: rejected (max depth 32; languages differ at 300 / 1200 otherwise).

vectors.name: json-duplicate-key
vectors.description: Duplicate "counter" key: rejected (languages differ on first-wins / last-wins).

vectors.name: json-duplicate-key-escaped
vectors.description: Duplicate key spelled with a \u escape ("coun\u0074er"): rejected.

vectors.name: json-trailing-comma
vectors.description: Trailing comma: rejected.

vectors.name: json-bom
vectors.description: UTF-8 BOM (U+FEFF) before the document: rejected.

vectors.name: json-trailing-garbage
vectors.description: Trailing non-whitespace after the document: rejected.

vectors.name: json-nonbreaking-space
vectors.description: U+00A0 as whitespace: rejected (only space, \t, \n, \r).

vectors.name: json-raw-control-char-in-string
vectors.description: A raw U+0009 inside a string: rejected.

vectors.name: json-single-quotes
vectors.description: Single-quoted strings: rejected.

vectors.name: json-not-an-object
vectors.description: The document is a JSON array, not an object: rejected.

vectors.name: pq-hybrid-valid
vectors.description: Hybrid ed25519+ml-dsa-65 PCActn: both signatures valid over the same canonical message.

vectors.name: pq-hybrid-corrupt-mldsa
vectors.description: Hybrid with a VALID Ed25519 sig but a corrupted ML-DSA sig: leaf_signature fails (both required).

vectors.name: pq-hybrid-corrupt-ed25519
vectors.description: Hybrid with a corrupted Ed25519 sig but a VALID ML-DSA sig: leaf_signature fails (both required).

vectors.name: pq-hybrid-missing-pqsig
vectors.description: Hybrid alg with no pq_sig: wire fails (pq_sig is required for the hybrid suite).

vectors.name: pq-mldsa65-valid
vectors.description: Pure ml-dsa-65 PCActn: ML-DSA signature in sig verifies under pq_pk.

vectors.name: pq-mldsa65-corrupt
vectors.description: Pure ml-dsa-65 with a corrupted signature: leaf_signature fails.

vectors.name: pq-unknown-alg
vectors.description: Unknown signature alg: wire fails closed (the registry is a closed set).

vectors.name: pq-ed25519-stray-pqpk
vectors.description: Default (ed25519, absent alg) object with a stray pq_pk: wire fails (pq_pk forbidden for ed25519).

vectors.name: pq-nonleaf-hybrid-hop-valid
vectors.description: Capability chain whose delegation hop (agent -> sub-agent) is HYBRID ed25519+ml-dsa-65 signed; leaf is ed25519. Both hop signatures and the leaf verify: all checks pass.

vectors.name: pq-nonleaf-hybrid-hop-corrupt-mldsa
vectors.description: Hybrid hop with a VALID ed25519 signature but a corrupted ML-DSA hop signature (leaf re-signed over the altered body): chain fails (a hybrid hop requires BOTH, so the ML-DSA half of a non-leaf hop is really checked).

vectors.name: pq-nonleaf-hybrid-hop-downgrade
vectors.description: Hybrid hop stripped of alg/pq_pk/pq_sig to forge a downgrade to ed25519 (leaf re-signed): wire passes but chain fails — alg+pq_pk are bound into the signed hop body_digest, so dropping them no longer matches the stored digest.

vectors.name: pq-nonleaf-mldsa65-hop-valid
vectors.description: Capability chain whose delegation hop is PURE ml-dsa-65 signed (the 3309-byte hop sig is the ML-DSA signature under the issuer pq_pk); leaf is ed25519. All checks pass.

vectors.name: pq-nonleaf-mldsa65-hop-corrupt
vectors.description: Pure ml-dsa-65 hop with a corrupted hop signature (leaf re-signed over the altered body): chain fails (the ML-DSA hop signature is verified under the issuer pq_pk, not skipped).
